episodes.name: episode 1
episodes.material: alto repeats bass run of 5-6; soprano alludes to falling steps of 3-4; bass recalls range of subject

episodes.name: episode 2
episodes.material: triple interchangeable counterpoint from beginning of codetta (bar 3) with 'countersubject' figures

episodes.name: episode 3
episodes.material: interchange of episode 2, cadence in vi at 16, then material of ep.1

episodes.name: episode 4
episodes.material: interchange of episode 2 then different material: tenor semiquaver run, alto alludes to subject opening imitated by soprano

episodes.name: episode 5
episodes.material: tenor of 24 repeated; soprano and alto extend last figure

episodes.name: episode 6
episodes.sequence: harmonic sequence rising to 32, then falling to interrupted cadence at 33

countersubjects.notes: continuation of bar 2 is not a countersubject; entries accompanied by varied combinations of some ten semiquaver figures, six also inverted

subject.ends: on the dominant but not in the dominant key (like I.6)
subject.answer: tonal; tonal change at second note; can be harmonized entirely in the tonic since no leading-note in the subject
subject.notes: seven-note subject; table of harmonizations of the subject (pdf 119)

Continuation of bar 2 is not a countersubject; some ten semiquaver figures in varied combination accompany later entries
